T: Don't make a sound. Not even when you chew.
D: A family lives in silence on a farm to avoid blind creatures that hunt by sound.
P: Serve the mains when the family eats dinner off leaves instead of plates.
S: Lettuce leaf chicken and rice cups
Shredded poached chicken and jasmine rice in lettuce leaves with lime and fish sauce

Soft butter lettuce cups filled with sticky rice, poached chicken, cucumber and herbs, dressed with a lime and fish sauce dressing and crushed peanuts. Poach 500g chicken breast in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest, then shred. Cook 200g jasmine rice. Mix the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 sliced red chilli. Separate 2 butter lettuces into cups. Fill each with rice, chicken, sliced Lebanese cucumber, mint and coriander, spoon over the dressing and finish with 50g crushed roasted peanuts.
Soft pretzels with warm cheddar sauce
Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, with a soft cheese dip of cheddar melted into evaporated milk.
the corn silo, minus the danger

Mini cornbread muffins with sweet corn kernels and cheddar, baked golden and split warm with whipped honey butter. Mix 150g fine cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, half a tsp salt and 1 tbsp sugar. Whisk in 300ml buttermilk, 1 egg, 60g melted butter, 150g corn kernels and 60g grated cheddar until just combined. Spoon into a buttered 24-hole mini muffin tin and bake at 200C for 12 to 14 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm bites.
M: Foil baked trout with lemon and dill
Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, baked in foil
Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, wrapped in foil with butter, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, opened at the table. New potatoes on the side.
a pot that cooks without a sound

Beef chuck braised for hours in red wine and stock until it falls apart, with soft buttery mash so nothing at the table makes a crunch. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck with 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks for 8 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 250ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash very smooth with 80g butter and 150ml warm milk. Spoon the beef over the mash.
W: Pears poached in sugar syrup under soft vanilla custard
Yolks whisked with sugar and cornflour, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat until thick, vanilla added, chilled in cups with poached pears.
K: Cucumber ribbons, mint, lime and elderflower with sparkling water, no alcohol

Chilled sparkling water poured gently over cucumber ribbons, crushed mint and lime with a touch of elderflower cordial, so nothing clinks. Shave 1 Lebanese cucumber into ribbons with a peeler. Lightly crush a handful of mint with the juice of 2 limes and 60ml elderflower cordial in a jug. Add the cucumber and 1L chilled sparkling water slowly. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice rather than cubes so they stay quiet, pour over and top with a mint sprig.

s.n: Lettuce leaf chicken and rice cups
s.note: Shredded poached chicken and jasmine rice in lettuce leaves with lime and fish sauce
s.how: Poach 500g chicken breast in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest, then shred. Cook 200g jasmine rice. Mix the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 sliced red chilli. Separate 2 butter lettuces into cups. Fill each with rice, chicken, sliced Lebanese cucumber, mint and coriander, spoon over the dressing and finish with 50g crushed roasted peanuts.

s.note: Soft pretzels with warm cheddar sauce
s.how: Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth. Serve warm, and dip quietly.

m.n: Foil baked trout with lemon and dill
m.note: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, baked in foil
m.how: Stuff 2 whole trout with lemon slices, dill and sliced garlic. Dot with 40g butter and wrap each in foil. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes and open at the table. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter.

w.note: Pears poached in sugar syrup under soft vanilla custard
w.how: Poach 2 peeled, halved pears in sugar syrup for 15 minutes. Whisk 4 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour. Pour over 400ml hot milk and 100ml cream, then stir over low heat until thick. Add vanilla, chill in cups and top with the pears.
